limits: No PostgreSQL, object store, dispatcher loop or served HTTP walk was run; the job authority is exercised through an in-memory ledger.

If a lease is lost mid-run, the renew inside a layer's retain or enrolment fails and fanOutZipLayers records that layer with the conflict code; the completion then fails and the dispatcher reclaims the job (at most three attempts), and the rerun keeps nothing twice.
A job that fails after its lease expired cannot fence itself (as with intake-draft); it stays running until the dispatcher reclaims it.
